en.bdb: Guru has explained the technique of yoga to the Sikhs.
Remain detached amidst all the hopes and cravings.
Eat less food and drink little water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਥੋੜਾ ਬੋਲਣ ਬੋਲ ਨ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: thoRaa bolan bol na jhakh jhakhaiaa|

en.bdb: Speak less and do not talk nonsensical.

verses.gurmukhi: ਥੋੜੀ ਰਾਤੀ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਫਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: thoRee raatee needh na moh fahaiaa|

en.bdb: Sleep less and do not be caught in any infatuation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਹਣੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਲੋਭ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit_en: suhane a(n)dhar jai na lobh lubhaiaa ||15||

en.bdb: Sleep less and do not be caught in any infatuation.
